description: A shell script for preparing the host environment in an Android Cuttlefish project, which includes functions for installing packages, checking service status, loading kernel modules, granting device access, and creating test users.

methods.name: install_pkgs
methods.description: Installs specified .deb packages from a given directory.

methods.name: check_service_started
methods.description: Checks if a given systemd service is active.

methods.name: grant_device_access
methods.description: Grants read/write permissions to device files.

methods.name: create_test_user
methods.description: Creates a new user with specific group memberships.
